description: Na₂Si₂O₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.65 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₄Si trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
